en_title: Ubisoft Says Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Boosted Assassin's Creed Odyssey Sales
cn_title: 育碧称克里斯托弗·诺兰的《奥德赛》推动了《Assassin's Creed Odyssey》的销量
opus_summary: 育碧表示，克里斯托弗·诺兰的电影《奥德赛》带动了《Assassin's Creed Odyssey》的持续销售。育碧还称，《Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced》的表现推动了最新财报超出预期，并表示该系列将在明年迎来20周年。

paragraphs.en: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey sparked a fresh surge in back-catalog sales for 2018's Assassin's Creed Odyssey , Ubisoft has said.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧表示，克里斯托弗·诺兰的《奥德赛》带动了2018年推出的旧作《Assassin's Creed Odyssey》销量再度激增。

paragraphs.en: In its latest financial results briefing, the Assassin's Creed publisher noted how a "major summer movie" had "materially benefited" the continued sales of its brilliant Ancient Greek game. Over the summer, Ubisoft re-promoted Assassin's Creed Odyssey alongside the launch of Nolan's film, inviting players to go start their own epic journey for themselves after returning home from theaters.
paragraphs.cn: 在最新的财报简报中，《Assassin's Creed》发行商指出，一部「暑期大片」如何「切实促进」了这款出色的古希腊题材游戏的持续销售。今年夏天，育碧在诺兰的电影上映之际重新推广了《Assassin's Creed Odyssey》，邀请玩家从电影院回家后亲自开启自己的史诗旅程。

paragraphs.en: Once again, Ubisoft used its financial update to praise the evergreen sales of its Assassin's Creed back catalog. Also, once again, it failed to provide any further detail on how last year's Assassin's Creed Shadows had fared. There's a sense that the long-awaited feudal Japan blockbuster has been a commercial disappointment for Ubisoft, and it's been a while since we had any formal update on sales numbers. No further content for the game is on the way, either — even though 2020's Valhalla just got a New Game Plus mode.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧再次利用财报更新赞扬了《Assassin's Creed》系列旧作经久不衰的销量。同时，它也再次没有提供去年《刺客信条：影》表现如何的更多细节。人们感觉，这款备受期待的日本封建时代题材大作在商业表现上令育碧失望，而我们也有一段时间没有得到有关销量数字的正式更新了。这款游戏也不会再有新内容推出——尽管2020年的《Valhalla》刚刚获得了新游戏加模式。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, Shadows is not mentioned at all in the results, despite Ubisoft commenting on Odyssey, Valhalla (which also just passed 40 million players), and this year's Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced — the latter of which has clearly had a successful launch.
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，育碧在财报中完全没有提及《刺客信条：影》，尽管它谈到了《Odyssey》、《Valhalla》（其玩家人数也刚刚突破4000万）以及今年推出的《Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced》——最后这款游戏显然取得了成功的首发表现。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft attributes an outperformance in its latest financial results to Resynced, which it describes as having been "among the industry's most successful Action-Adventure remakes." How did its launch compare to any all-new Assassin's Creed games? If it did surpass any of those, Ubisoft perhaps understandably isn't saying — but it's clear the game has been a hit.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧将最新财报中超出预期的表现归功于《Resynced》，并称它是「业内最成功的动作冒险重制游戏之一」。它的首发表现与任何全新的《Assassin's Creed》游戏相比如何？如果它确实超过了其中任何一款，育碧没有透露或许也可以理解——但显然这款游戏取得了成功。

paragraphs.en: "The franchise will celebrate its 20th anniversary next year," Ubisoft said, reiterating what fans have heard already — that 2027 should be a more exciting year for the series than the past 12 months have been. "This is a major milestone for the brand, which is preparing a year of reveals, updates, rewards, and community
paragraphs.cn: 「该系列明年将迎来20周年，」育碧表示，并重申了粉丝们已经听说过的消息——对该系列而言，2027年应该会比过去12个月更加令人兴奋。「这是该品牌的一个重要里程碑，品牌正在为这一年准备各种公开消息、更新、奖励和社区

paragraphs.en: It seems likely that next year will be when we get a first glimpse of the upcoming Assassin's Creed Hexe, the series' next blockbuster game, as well as Netflix's upcoming Assassin's Creed TV series set in Ancient Rome and a peek at Codename Invictus, a new multiplayer game spinoff. Until then, well, Assassin's Creed: Odyssey is really worth a go if you haven't played it already.
paragraphs.cn: 明年我们似乎很可能会首次见到即将推出的《Assassin's Creed Hexe》，即该系列的下一款大作，以及Netflix即将推出的古罗马背景电视剧《Assassin's Creed》，并一窥新的多人游戏衍生作《Codename Invictus》。在那之前，嗯，如果你还没玩过《Assassin's Creed: Odyssey》，它真的值得一试。
